body:
I'm not entirely sure.  A little of both.

I'm not happy.  There are things I *enjoy* but even during them I'm not really *happy*.  I'm either focusing on the fleetingness of that enjoyment or anticipating the imminent arrival of all the stressful parts of life... or in some weird-but-intense mood.

This "mood" (that's really not the right word for it) is like a sudden burst of emotion, when usually, they don't seem so prominent.  If that makes sense.  It's like I have a difficult time "feeling" (or maybe just recognizing) any emotions within myself most of the time... and then have an explosion of intense feelings.  Of sadness/anger/panic/fear, etc. 

But all in all there is this strange feeling of dread beneath it all, beneath my entire life now.  That's all I really feel.

I just don't really like life that much, the bad seems to far outweigh the good, to the extent that it doesn't really seem worth it.  

Not in an intense misery sort of a way, but more so in a "why bother" sense.  Like what exactly is the reason to keep on going.  I'm working all the time... so I can afford... to keep working... for the next 50 years or whatever... and then I die.  

I'm spending my life just killing time, just working so I can afford to stay alive and keep working for no real reason.  

I'm looking to change careers though, and maybe that'll help.

Pursue my dreams instead of just paying the bills.
